content:
sam: Taking the evening oncall swap — leaving a short watchlist and action items before I sign off. Main noisy signals to keep an eye on: kv-prefetch noise, encoder-pool slow drains, and EU latency tails on long-chat workloads.

tara: Thanks — appreciate the notes. Can you paste any quick repro/log snippets for the kv-prefetch flapping?

sam: Yep — saw this around 19:42 UTC, pattern was 3 short spikes over ~10m. Logs had repeated `prefetch_timeout` entries and a handful of `cache_miss` storms. snippet:```
[2026-03-17T19:42:11Z] prefetch: start seq=128 user=svc-int test-integration
[2026-03-17T19:42:12Z] prefetch: timeout seq=128 err=prefetch_timeout
[2026-03-17T19:42:14Z] kv: cache_miss burst=72
```

marta: Repro looks like bursty CI traffic hitting the prefetch layer. Yesterday i temporarily muted the channel alerts and added a 5m suppression rule, but it came back after the next integration run.

sam: Suggested oncall play: if kv-prefetch alerts flake >3 times in 20m, mute `kv-prefetch-noisy` for 15m and open a ticket to eng-infra with the `prefetch-debug` tag. If you see steady errors (not just spikes) escalate.

kevin: For encoder-pool slow drains — what's the safe workaround? last time we did a rolling restart of the encoder pods which recovered latency but caused a small throughput blip.

sam: Correct. Steps I used: 1) enable limited drain on one encoder node, 2) monitor `encoder_queue_depth` and `p50/p95` tokens. If drain >2min and queue climbs, abort and fallback to canary model route. Command I ran:```bash
# cordon + drain one node
kubectl cordon encoder-node-17
kubectl drain encoder-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
Watch metrics in console (route: eng-runtime > encoder-pool).

marta: Noted. Also FYI: EU long-chat latency tail shows in `latency_tail_by_model` for seq>1024 — seems correlated with a specific model variant `rw-v2-long`. If tails appear, route traffic to `rw-v2-medium` via the routing policy until we investigate.

sam: Quick checklist for next oncall: 
• Monitor kv-prefetch error rate and suppression rules
• If encoder drain stalls, do a single-node drain and abort if queue grows
• If EU model tail persists >30m, switch routing policy to `rw-v2-medium` and open a model-regression ticket 

oncall-bot: Reminder — you have rotation handoff in 6h. See /oncall for full schedule :spiral_calendar_pad: 

tara: Pinged oncall-docs with these bullets and added links to the temporary suppression runbook. @kevin — can you own the encoder follow-up tomorrow morning?

kevin: Yep, I'll take it. I'll also add a short test to reproduce the prefetch burst locally.

sam: Thanks all — leaving at 20:22 UTC. If anything sticky pops up, escalate to eng-infra and drop notes in this thread. :thumbsup:
